```{r}
#| include: true
root <- here::here()
ID.target <- .resolveIDTarget(
  DEQTable,
  "DEQ.operation.qmd",
  base = TRUE,
  target = .currentTarget("ID.target"),
  siteID = .currentTarget("siteID.target")
)
if (!exists("Tn.target") || !length(Tn.target)) Tn.target <- 0
if (!exists("PSA_Units") || !length(PSA_Units)) PSA_Units <- "cm/s2"
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- readCaption("tbl.DEQ.operation")
Stage.target <- "Operation"
SiteID.caption <- .requireOneTarget(
  .currentTarget("siteID.target"), "siteID.target", "DEQ operation table caption"
)
```
